audit_findings.title: FY2025 anchor may retain net nonrecurring disposal gains
audit_findings.magnitude: $15.895m pre-tax disposal gains less $6.245m pre-tax impairment equals $9.650m net, 28.6% of the $33.8m anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: Potentially inflates anchor OE and every forecast year derived from it.
audit_findings.evidence: Corporate expenses, including deferred compensation, environmental remediation, a $6.2 million goodwill impairment charge and $15.9 million of gains recognized on the sale of assets, decreased $19.0 million, or 25 percent, year-over-year.
audit_findings.explanation: The nonrecurring items are demonstrated, but their treatment in the supplied anchor is not. If neither adjustment was made, reported income was inflated by $9.650m pre-tax on a net basis. That scale is reasonably capable of materially changing the DCF, although the actual after-tax OE error remains unresolved.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile $33.8m line by line to FY2025 net income; document the after-tax removal of both disposal gains and any eligible noncash addback for the impairment, then rerun all scenarios if the anchor changes.

audit_findings.title: Known 2026 shutdown program is absent from the anchor and perimeter
audit_findings.magnitude: $70.545m pre-tax restructuring expense through June 2026, including $61.309m asset impairment, $7.509m decommissioning/other expense and $1.727m termination expense; $3.663m paid through June; full-year charges forecast at $75m-$80m
audit_findings.mechanism: Cash shutdown costs reduce near-term OE, while closures can alter recurring margins, maintenance capital, working capital and growth.
audit_findings.evidence: Total restructuring expenses related to these asset shutdowns are expected to approximate $ 70,000,000 to $ 80,000,000 in 2026.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated post-anchor event, not merely a possibility. Most recorded expense is noncash impairment and should not automatically reduce OE, but cash costs and post-closure operating economics are not represented by the null perimeter. The affected amounts exceed the $33.8m anchor, and recurring savings or operating disruption could materially move value in either direction.
audit_findings.action: Build a 2026 restructuring bridge separating noncash impairment, cash paid, remaining liabilities and future cash charges; establish post-closure revenue, margins, maintenance capex and working capital, and rerun the DCF on normalized post-closure OE.

audit_findings.title: Unfunded legacy environmental and legal claims are missing from the bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $19.619m accrued and $46.483m upper estimated loss at June 2026; $26.864m incremental exposure above the accrual equals $1.11 per share and 4.6% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Past-condition cash settlements may escape forecast OE and therefore require an equity-bridge deduction to the extent unfunded and not otherwise captured.
audit_findings.evidence: After partial remediation payments at certain sites, the Company has estimated a range of possible environmental and legal losses of $19.3 million to $46.0 million at December 31, 2025, and $20.0 million to $44.5 million at December 31, 2024.
audit_findings.explanation: The missing treatment is a real bridge issue, but the filed range supplies a usable ceiling. Deducting the entire $46.483m upper estimate would reduce base value by about $1.92 per share, from $24.25 to approximately $22.34, still far below the $63.42 market price. It therefore cannot change the present valuation conclusion on the supplied record.
audit_findings.action: Verify the June 2026 reserve, recoveries and payment schedule; for completeness, rerun the bridge deducting only past-condition cash claims not already captured in OE, with the filed upper estimate as the sensitivity ceiling.

audit_findings.title: The Philippines sale changes operating economics despite a null perimeter
audit_findings.magnitude: H1 2026 Asia Surfactants sales decreased $17.665m and gross profit decreased $5.611m year over year; net recurring OE effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: The tolling model changes recurring operating margin, working capital and maintenance-capital requirements relative to the owned-manufacturing economics represented in FY2025.
audit_findings.evidence: As part of the transaction, SPQI entered into a tolling agreement with Masurf, Inc. to continue to serve its customers in Southeast Asia and support growth opportunities in this region.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter change and substantial decline in Asian activity are demonstrated. The record does not isolate tolling fees, retained contribution profit, working-capital release or avoided maintenance capex, so it cannot establish the net OE effect or its materiality. Lower manufacturing profit could be partly or fully offset by reduced capital intensity.
audit_findings.action: Obtain pro forma SPQI and Lake Providence revenue, gross profit, tolling expense, working capital and maintenance capex for comparable periods; normalize FY2025 to the retained perimeter and rerun if recurring OE changes materially.

audit_findings.title: Near-term refinancing could change the interest cost embedded in equity owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: $647.354m total debt at June 2026, including $403.285m current maturities and $344.0m under the credit facility; H1 2026 net interest expense increased $1.082m year over year; $100m is hedged through March 2027
audit_findings.mechanism: New borrowing rates flow through after-tax interest expense retained in equity-level OE.
audit_findings.explanation: The June filing shows that near-term debt remains financed largely through a facility maturing in June 2027, so the decisive refinancing terms are still forward-looking. The observed H1 interest increase equals only 3.2% of the $33.8m anchor before tax effects, while the eventual rate, maturity and hedge structure remain unknown.
audit_findings.action: Monitor the 2027 facility refinancing or replacement; once terms are filed, replace historical interest with contractual after-tax interest in forecast OE and rerun the scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The cash addback may not be fully distributable dollar for dollar
audit_findings.magnitude: $101.8m of $113.705m June 2026 cash was held by non-U.S. subsidiaries; complete exclusion of that foreign cash would reduce value by $4.19 per share and base value from $24.25 to approximately $20.06
audit_findings.mechanism: Restrictions and repatriation taxes reduce the equity-bridge value of cash added separately from operating OE.
audit_findings.evidence: Cash and cash equivalents of the Company’s non-U.S. subsidiaries held outside the U.S. totaled $116.5 million as of December 31, 2025.
audit_findings.explanation: Foreign concentration is demonstrated, while the actual haircut is unresolved. Even the extreme sensitivity of assigning zero value to all $101.8m of foreign cash would leave intrinsic value far below the $63.42 market price, so the finding cannot change the current valuation conclusion. A realistic tax or restriction haircut would be smaller.
audit_findings.action: Confirm the June cash by jurisdiction, legal restrictions, indefinite-reinvestment status and incremental distribution taxes; apply documented jurisdiction-specific haircuts to the bridge if desired.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: Approximately $3.5m of FY2018 D&A was unidentified, computed as the 4.3% residual of roughly $81.1m filed D&A
audit_findings.mechanism: Any eligible residual addback would increase FY2018 OE and potentially its historical trend, but it does not alter FY2025 anchor OE directly.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2018 $77.6m (95.7% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: The possible error is conservative and confined to one historical year. Even adding the entire computed residual would only raise FY2018 OE; the valuation already caps its $60m trend at the lower $33.8m latest-year OE. An upward FY2018 correction therefore cannot change the anchor or current valuation.
audit_findings.action: Classify the FY2018 residual for audit completeness; no valuation rerun is needed unless analogous unidentified D&A exists in FY2025 or a revised trend falls below the $33.8m anchor.
